rejected.text: High and Dry is a floating pirate town built from broken Brazen Coalition ships, a neutral ground for pirates.
Pages describe it as a harbor where Vraska's crew plans to make landfall and an outpost where Vraska and Jace docked and were overheard talking of the compass.
Later it is a pirate port where Malcolm knew Wayta and one that Malcolm fears is next.
The latest mention, in 2023, describes High and Dry as a pirate port that Malcolm fears is next.
